meta.title: useCallback — stale closure from a missing dependency

annotations.label: Component declaration
annotations.detail: StaleCbDemo shows what happens when useCallback omits a variable from its dep array: the callback freezes the value it closed over at creation time and never updates, even when the underlying state changes.

annotations.label: Stale closure — count frozen at 0
annotations.detail: The callback closes over count from the render that created it. Empty deps means it's never recreated, so `count` inside is always the mount-time value regardless of current state.

annotations.label: Correct dep list
annotations.detail: Adding count to the dep array re-creates the callback on every count change. The new closure sees the fresh value. The tradeoff: child components receiving this callback will also re-render when count changes.

steps.note: Empty dep array means this callback is created once — at mount.
Listing count as a dep means useCallback recreates the function
